tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — a cool drafting-paper white, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product cards, drawers, menus, the spec table.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, table rules, the blueprint grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on both surfaces).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: manufacturer, dimensions, metadata.

tokens.name: fusion-navy
tokens.usage: THE brand colour — the 'FUSION' in the logo. Primary buttons, links, active nav, selected states. As text on surface or brand-soft.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Dark brand fields: header bar, footer, hero bands. Text on it is on-brand (light theme) or ink (dark theme).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind fusion-navy text; product image wells; hover rows.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a fusion-navy fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: edge-green
tokens.usage: Signature accent — the 'EDGE' in the logo. Fills only: the Drag-to-Revit handle, drop-success, 'Revit-ready' marks. Never as text on light grounds (2:1); text on it is navy-ink.

tokens.name: navy-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed ON edge-green, in both themes (7:1).

tokens.name: edge-green-text
tokens.usage: Green as text: 'In stock', 'Loaded into Revit', success messages, on surface or green-soft.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind edge-green-text; the drop zone's success state.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Version mismatch (e.g. family saved in a newer Revit). As text on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed transfers. As text on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings (2px, 2px offset) — alias of fusion-navy.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — alias of fusion-navy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Parametric family with editable length, finish and lamp type.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and badges — echoes the logo's tracked tagline.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Dimensions, SKUs, parameter values, file names (.rfa).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the blueprint grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutters between product cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, drop zone — precise, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers, modals, image wells.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting product card (borders do most of the work).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card being dragged toward Revit — the only big shadow in the system.
